cleavage agent: the proteins in gel were digested by 0.02 μg/μl trypsin.
enrichment method: The SAMP1BocK24 and SAMP1Bock24-MoaE conjugate were purified by immunoprecipitation
instrument: Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
A total of 1 μg peptides was injected into an Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer equipped with an UltiMate 3000 UHPLC (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: The raw data was analyzed by Proteome Discoverer 1.4 with the Mascot search algorithm.
mass analyzer: A total of 1 μg peptides was injected into an Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer equipped with an UltiMate 3000 UHPLC (Thermo Scientific).
precursor tolerance: Precursor and fragment mass tolerance was set at 10 ppm and 50 mmu, respectively.
fragment tolerance: Precursor and fragment mass tolerance was set at 10 ppm and 50 mmu, respectively.
ptm: Carbamidomethyl of cysteine (fixed); Deamidation of Asn and Gln (variable); oxidation of Met (variable)
Carbamidomethyl of cysteine was specified as a fixed modification. Deamidation of Asn and Gln and oxidation of Met were specified as variable modifications.
